english_title: 32. His Supplication in the Night Prayer

phrases.arabic: أَللَّهُمَّ يَا ذَا الْمُلْكِ الْمُتأبِّدِ بِالْخُلُودِ وَالْسُلْطَانِ
phrases.english: 1.O God, O Possessor of kingdom perpetual in everlastingness,

phrases.arabic: الْمُمْتَنِعِ بِغَيْرِ جُنُود وَلاَ أَعْوَان،
phrases.english: 2.authority invincible without armies or helpers,

phrases.arabic: وَالْعِزِّ الْبَاقِي عَلَى مَرِّ الدُّهُورِ،
phrases.english: 3.might abiding through aeons past,

phrases.arabic: وَخَوَالِي الأَعْوَامِ، وَمَوَاضِي الأَزْمَانِ وَالأيَّامِ،
phrases.english: 4.years gone by, times and days elapsed!

phrases.arabic: عَزَّ سُلْطَانُكَ عِزّاً لا حَدَّ  لَهُ بِأَوَّلِيَّةٍ وَلاَ مُنْتَهَى لَهُ بِآخِرِيَّةٍ،
phrases.english: 5.Your authority is mighty with a might that knows no bound by being first nor utmost end by being last!

phrases.arabic: وَاسْتَعْلَى مُلْكُكَ عُلُوّاً سَقَطَتِ الأشْيَاءُ دُونَ بُلُوغِ أَمَدِهِ
phrases.english: 6.Your kingdom towers high with a towering before which all things fall down without reaching its term;

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ يَبْلُغُ أَدْنَى مَا اسْتَأثَرْتَ بِـهِ مِنْ ذَلِكَ أَقْصَى نَعْتِ النَّـاعِتِينَ.
phrases.english: 7.the least of it which You hast kept to Yourself is not reached by the furthest description of the describers!

phrases.arabic: ضَلَّتْ فِيْـكَ الصِّفَاتُ وَتَفَسْخَتْ دُونَكَ النُّعُوتُ
phrases.english: 8.Attributes go astray in You, descriptions fall apart below You,

phrases.arabic: وَحَارَتْ فِي كِبْرِيِائِكَ لَطَائِفُ الأوْهَامِ،
phrases.english: 9.the subtlest of imaginations are bewildered by Your magnificence!

phrases.arabic: كَذلِكَ أَنْتَ اللهُ الأَوَّلُ فِي أَوَّلِيَّتِكَ،
phrases.english: 10.So art Thou: God, the First in Your firstness,

phrases.arabic: وَعَلَى ذَلِكَ أَنْتَ دَائِمٌ لا تَزُولُ،
phrases.english: 11.and so art You everlastingly. You dost not pass away.

phrases.arabic: وَأَنَا الْعَبْدُ الضَّعِيْفُ عَمَلاً الجَسِيْمُ أَمَلاً،
phrases.english: 12.But I am the slave, feeble in works, immense in hopes.

phrases.arabic: خَرَجَتْ  مِنْ يَدِي أَسْبَابُ الْوُصُلاَت إلاّ مَا وَصَلَهُ رَحْمَتُكَ ،
phrases.english: 13.The tying links are outside my hand, except what is tied by Your mercy;

phrases.arabic: وَتَقَطَّعَتْ عَنِّي عِصَمُ الآمَالِ
phrases.english: 14.the bonds of hopes have been cut away from me,

phrases.arabic: إلاّ مَا أَنَا مُعْتَصِمٌ بِهِ مِنْ عَفْوِكَ،
phrases.english: 15.except the pardon to which I hold fast.

phrases.arabic: قَلَّ عِنْدِي مَا أَعْتَدُّ بِهِ مِنْ طَاعَتِكَ
phrases.english: 16.Little on my part is the obedience toward You upon which I count,

phrases.arabic: وَكَثُرَ عَلَيَّ مَا أَبُوءُ بِهِ مِنْ مَعْصِيَتِكَ،
phrases.english: 17.and great against me the disobedience toward You to which I have reverted.

phrases.arabic: وَلَنْ يَضِيْقَ عَلَيْكَ عَفْوٌ عَنْ عَبْدِكَ وَإنْ أَسَاءَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي.
phrases.english: 18.But pardoning Your slave will not constrain You, even if he be bad, so pardon me!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهًمَّ وَقَدْ أَشْرَفَ  عَلَى خَفَايَا الأَعْمَالِ عِلْمُكَ
phrases.english: 19.O God, Your knowledge watches over hidden works

phrases.arabic: وَانْكَشَفَ كُلُّ مَسْتُور دُونَ خُبْرِكَ
phrases.english: 20.every covered thing is exposed before Your awareness,

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ تَنْطَوِي عَنْكَ دَقَائِقُ  الأُمُورِ
phrases.english: 21.the intricacies of things are not concealed from You,

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ تَعْزُبُ عَنْكَ غَيِّبَاتُ السَّرَائِرِ،
phrases.english: 22.and unseen mysteries slip not away from You.

phrases.arabic: وَقَدِ اسْتَحْوَذَ عَلَيَّ عَدُوُّكَ الَّذِي اسْتَنْظَرَكَ  لِغِوَايتِي فَأَنْظَرْتَهُ،
phrases.english: 23.But over me Your enemy has gained mastery: He asked a delay from You to lead me astray, and You gavest him the delay!

phrases.arabic: وَاسْتَمْهَلَكَ إلَى يَوْمِ الدِّيْنِ لاِضْلاَلِي فَأَمْهَلْتَهُ،
phrases.english: 24.He asked a respite from You until the Day of Doom to misguide me, and You gavest him the respite!

phrases.arabic: فَأوْقَعَنِيْ وَقَدْ هَرَبْتُ إلَيْكَ
phrases.english: 25.So he threw me down, though I had fled to You

phrases.arabic: مِنْ صَغَائِرِ ذُنُوبٍ مُوبِقَةٍ
phrases.english: 26.from small, ruinous sins

phrases.arabic: وَكَبَائِرِ أَعْمَالٍ مُرْدِيَـةٍ
phrases.english: 27.and great, deadly works,

phrases.arabic: حَتَّى إذَا قَارَفْتُ مَعْصِيَتَـكَ
phrases.english: 28.until, when I had yielded to disobeying You

phrases.arabic: وَاسْتَوْجَبْتُ بِسُوءِ سَعْيِي سَخْطَتَكَ
phrases.english: 29.and merited Your anger through my bad efforts,

phrases.arabic: فَتَلَ عَنِّي عِذَارَ غَدْرِهِ،
phrases.english: 30.he turned the bridle of his treachery away from me,

phrases.arabic: وَتَلَقَّانِي بكَلِمَةِ كُفْرهِ،
phrases.english: 31.met me with the word of his ingratitude,

phrases.arabic: وَتَوَلَّى الْبَراءَةَ مِنِّي وَأَدْبَرَ مُوَلِّيَاً عَنِّي،
phrases.english: 32.undertook to be quit of me, turned his back to flee from me,

phrases.arabic: فَأَصْحَرنِي لِغَضَبِكَ فَرِيداً،
phrases.english: 33.threw me to the desert of Your wrath alone,

phrases.arabic: وَأَخْرَجَني إلى فِنَاءِ نَقِمَتِكَ طَرِيداً
phrases.english: 34.and sent me as an outcast into the courtyard of Your vengeance.

phrases.arabic: لاَ شَفِيعٌ يَشْفَعُ لِيْ إلَيْـكَ،
phrases.english: 35.There is no intercessor to intercede for me with You,

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ خَفِيـرٌ يُؤْمِنُنِي عَلَيْـكَ
phrases.english: 36.no protector to make me feel secure against You,

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ حِصْنٌ يَحْجُبُنِي عَنْكَ
phrases.english: 37.no fortress to veil me from You,

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ مَلاَذٌ أَلْجَأُ إلَيْهِ مِنْكَ.
phrases.english: 38.no shelter in which to seek asylum apart from You!

phrases.arabic: فَهَذَا مَقَامُ الْعَائِذِ بِكَ، وَمَحَلُّ الْمُعْتَرِفِ لَكَ،
phrases.english: 39.This is the station of him who takes refuge with You, the place of the confessor to You:

phrases.arabic: فَلاَ يَضِيقَنَّ عَنِّي فَضْلُكَ، وَلا يَقْصُـرَنَّ دونِي عَفْوُكَ،
phrases.english: 40.Let not Your bounty be too narrow for me, let not Your pardon fall short of me!

phrases.arabic: وَلا أكُنْ أَخْيَبَ عِبَادِكَ التَّائِبِينَ،
phrases.english: 41.Let me not be the most disappointed of Your repentant servants,

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ أَقْنَطَ وفُودِكَ الآمِلِينَ
phrases.english: 42.nor the most despairing of those who come to You with expectations!

phrases.arabic: وَاغْفِرْ لِي إنَّكَ  خَيْرُ الْغَافِرِينَ.
phrases.english: 43.Forgive me, surely You art the best of the forgivers!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ إنَّكَ أَمَرْتَنِي فَتَرَكْتُ، وَنَهَيْتَنِي فَرَكِبْتُ،
phrases.english: 44.O God, You commanded me, and I refrained, You prohibited me, and I committed.

phrases.arabic: وَسَوَّلَ لِيَ الْخَطَأَ خَاطِرُ  السُّوءِ فَفَرَّطْتُ،
phrases.english: 45.evil thoughts tempted me to offend, and I was negligent.

phrases.arabic: وَلا أَسْتَشْهِدُ عَلَى صِيَامِي نَهَـاراً،
phrases.english: 46.I cannot call upon daytime to witness my fasting,

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ أَسْتَجِيرُ بِتَهَجُّدِي لَيْلاً،
phrases.english: 47.nor can I seek sanctuary in night because of my vigil;

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ تُثْنِي عَلَيَّ بِإحْيَائِهَا سُنَّةٌ
phrases.english: 48.no Sunna praises me for keeping it alive,

phrases.arabic: حَـاشَا فُرُوضِـكَ الَّتِي مَنْ ضَيَّعَها هَلَكَ،
phrases.english: 49.only Your obligations, he who neglects which has perished.

phrases.arabic: وَلَسْتُ أَتَوَسَّلُ إلَيْكَ بِفَضْلِ نَافِلَة
phrases.english: 50.I cannot seek access to You through the excellence of a supererogatory work,

phrases.arabic: مَعَ كَثِيرِ مَا أَغْفَلْتُ مِنْ وَظَائِفِ فُرُوضِكَ،
phrases.english: 51.given the many duties of Your obligations of which I have been heedless

phrases.arabic: وَتَعَدَّيْتُ عَنْ مَقَامَاتِ حُدُودِكَ
phrases.english: 52.and the stations of Your bounds which I have transgressed,

phrases.arabic: إلَى حُرُمَات انْتَهَكْتُهَا، وَكَبَائِرِ ذُنُوب اجْتَرَحْتُهَا
phrases.english: 53.thereby violating sacred things and committing great sins,

phrases.arabic: كَانَتْ عَافِيَتُكَ لِي مِنْ فَضَائِحِهَا سِتْراً.
phrases.english: 54.though You hast given me safety from their disgraces as a covering.

phrases.arabic: وَهَذَا مَقَامُ مَنِ اسْتَحْيَى لِنَفْسِهِ مِنْكَ،
phrases.english: 55.This is the station of him who is ashamed of himself before You,

phrases.arabic: وَسَخِطَ عَلَيْهَا، وَرَضِيَ عَنْكَ
phrases.english: 56.angry with himself, and satisfied with You.

phrases.arabic: فَتَلَقَّاكَ بِنَفْس خَاشِعَة، وَرَقَبَة خَاضِعَة، وَظَهْر مُثْقَل مِنَ الْخَطَايَا
phrases.english: 57.He meets You with a humble soul, a neck bent down, a back heavy with offenses,

phrases.arabic: وَاقِفاً بَيْنَ الرَّغْبَةِ إلَيْكَ وَالرَّهْبَةِ مِنْكَ،
phrases.english: 58.hesitating between longing for You and fear of You.

phrases.arabic: وَأَنْتَ أَوْلَى مَنْ رَجَـاهُ،
phrases.english: 59.You art the most worthy of those in whom he might hope,

phrases.arabic: وَأَحَقُّ مَنْ خَشِيَـهُ وَاتّقـاهُ،
phrases.english: 60.the most deserving for him to dread and fear.

phrases.arabic: فَاعْطِنِي يَا رَبِّ مَا رَجَوْتُ، وَآمِنِّي مَا حَذِرْتُ،
phrases.english: 61.So give me, my Lord, what I hope for, make me secure against what frightens me,

phrases.arabic: وَعُدْ عَلَيَّ بِعَائِدَةِ رَحْمَتِكَ إنَّكَ أكْرَمُ الْمَسْؤُولِينَ.
phrases.english: 62.and act kindly toward me with the kindly act of mercy! Surely You art the most generous of those from whom are asked!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ وَإذْ سَتَـرْتَنِي بِعَفْوِكَ وَتَغَمَّـدْتَنِي بِفَضْلِكَ
phrases.english: 63.O God, since You hast covered me with Your pardon and shielded me with Your bounty

phrases.arabic: فِي  دَارِ الْفَنَاءِ بِحَضرَةِ الأكْفَاءِ
phrases.english: 64.in the abode of annihilation and the presence of equals

phrases.arabic: فَأَجِرْنِي مِنْ فَضِيحَاتِ دَارِ الْبَقَاءِ
phrases.english: 65.grant me sanctuary from the disgraces of the Abode of Subsistence

phrases.arabic: عِنْدَ مَوَاقِفِ الأشْهَادِ مِنَ المَلائِكَةِ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ
phrases.english: 66.at the standing places of the Witnesses (the angels brought nigh,

phrases.arabic: وَالرُّسُلِ الْمُكَرَّمِينَ وَالشُّهَدَاءِ وَالصَّالِحِينَ،
phrases.english: 67.the messengers honoured, the martyrs, the righteous)

phrases.arabic: مِنْ جَار كُنْتُ أُكَاتِمُهُ سَيِّئاتِي
phrases.english: 68.before the neighbour from whom I have hidden my evil deeds

phrases.arabic: وَمِنْ ذِي رَحِم كُنْتُ أَحْتَشِمُ مِنْهُ فِي سَرِيرَاتِي،
phrases.english: 69.and the womb relative before whom I feel ashamed in my secret thoughts!

phrases.arabic: لَمْ أَثِقْ بِهِمْ رَبِّ فِي السِّتْرِ عَلَيَّ،
phrases.english: 70.I trust them not, my Lord, to cover me over,

phrases.arabic: وَوَثِقْتُ  بِكَ رَبِّ فِي الْمَغفِرَةِ لِيْ،
phrases.english: 71.but I trust You, my Lord, to forgive me!

phrases.arabic: وَأَنْتَ أوْلَى مَنْ وُثِقَ بِهِ وَأَعْطَى مَنْ رُغِبَ إلَيْهِ
phrases.english: 72.You art the most worthy of those in whom confidence is had, the most giving of those who are besought,

phrases.arabic: وَأَرْأَفُ مَنِ اسْتُرْحِمَ فَارْحَمْنِي.
phrases.english: 73.and the most clement of those from whom mercy is asked. So have mercy upon me!

phrases.arabic: أللهُمَّ وَأنتَ حَدَرْتَنِي مَاءً مَهِيناً مِنْ صُلب،
phrases.english: 74.O God, You caused me to descend as mean water from loins

phrases.arabic: مُتَضَائِقِ الْعِظَامِ حَرِجِ الْمَسَالِكِ
phrases.english: 75.of narrow bones and tight passages

phrases.arabic: إلَى رَحِم ضَيِّقَة سَتَرْتَهَا بِالْحُجُبِ
phrases.english: 76.into a constricted womb which You hadst covered with veils;

phrases.arabic: تُصَرِّفُنِي حَالاًَ عَنْ حَال حَتَّى انْتَهَيْتَ بِيْ إلَى تَمَامِ الصُّورَةِ
phrases.english: 77.You turned me about from state to state until You tookest me to the completion of the form

phrases.arabic: وَأَثْبَتَّ فِيَّ الْجَوَارحَ
phrases.english: 78.and fixed within me the bodily parts,

phrases.arabic: كَمَا نَعَتَّ فِي كِتَابِكَ
phrases.english: 79.as You hast described in Your Book:

phrases.arabic: نُطْفَةً ثُمَّ عَلَقَةً ثُمَّ مُضْغَةً ثُمَّ عِظَاماً
phrases.english: 80.a drop, then a clot, then a tissue, then bones,

phrases.arabic: ثُمَّ كَسَوْتَ الْعِظَامَ لَحْماً ثُمَّ أَنْشَأتَنِي خَلْقَاً آخَرَ كَمَا شِئْتَ،
phrases.english: 81.then You garmented the bones with flesh, then You produced me as another creature as You willed (ref.23:12-14).

phrases.arabic: حَتَّى إذَا احْتَجْتُ إلَى رِزْقِكَ،
phrases.english: 82.Then, when I needed Your provision,

phrases.arabic: وَلَمْ أَسْتَغْنِ عَنْ غِيَـاثِ فَضْلِكَ
phrases.english: 83.and could not do without the aid of Your bounty,

phrases.arabic: جَعَلْتَ لِي قُـوتـاً مِنْ فَضْلِ طَعَام وَشَرَاب
phrases.english: 84.You appointed for me a nourishment from the bounty of the food and drink

phrases.arabic: أَجْرَيْتَهُ لاِمَتِكَ  الَّتِيْ أَسْكَنْتَنِي جَوْفَهَا وَأَوْدَعْتَنِي قَرَارَ رَحِمِهَا،
phrases.english: 85.which You bestowed upon Your handmaid in whose belly You gavest me to rest and in the lodging of whose womb You deposited me.

phrases.arabic: وَلَوْ تَكِلُنِي يَا رَبِّ فِي تِلْكَ الْحَـالاتِ إلَى حَوْلِي،
phrases.english: 86.Hadst You entrusted me in those states, my Lord, to my own force

phrases.arabic: أَوْ تَضْطَرُّنِي إلَى قُوّتي
phrases.english: 87.or driven me to have recourse to my own strength,

phrases.arabic: لَكَانَ الْحَوْلُ عَنِّي مُعْتَزِلاً، وَلَكَانَتِ الْقُوَّةُ مِنِّي بَعِيدَةً،
phrases.english: 88.force would have been removed from me and strength taken far away.

phrases.arabic: فَغَذَوْتَنِي بِفَضْلِكَ غِذَاءَ البَرِّ اللَّطِيفِ ،
phrases.english: 89.So You hast fed me through Your bounty with the food of the Good, the Gentle;

phrases.arabic: تَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ بِي تَطَوُّلاً عَلَيَّ إلَى غَايَتِي هَذِهِ،
phrases.english: 90.You hast done that for me in graciousness toward me up to this my present point.

phrases.arabic: لاَ أَعْدَمُ بِرَّكَ وَلاَ يُبْطِئُ بِي حُسْنُ صَنِيعِكَ،
phrases.english: 91.I do not lack Your goodness nor does Your benefaction keep me waiting.

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ تَتَأكَّدُ مَعَ ذَلِكَ ثِقَتِي،
phrases.english: 92.Yet with all that, my trust has not become firm enough

phrases.arabic: فَأَتَفَرَّغَ لِمَا هُوَ أَحْظَى لِيْ عِنْدَكَ،
phrases.english: 93.that I might free myself for that which is more favoured by You.

phrases.arabic: قَدْ مَلَكَ الشَّيْطَانُ عِنَانِي فِي سُوءِ الظَّنِّ وَضَعْفِ الْيَقِينِ،
phrases.english: 94.Satan has taken possession of my reins through my distrust and frail certainty.

phrases.arabic: فَأَنَا أَشْكُو سُوْءَ مُجَاوَرَتِهِ لِي وَطَـاعَةَ نَفْسِي لَـهُ،
phrases.english: 95.I complain of his evil neighbourhood with me and my soul's obedience toward him!

phrases.arabic: وَأَسْتَعْصِمُـكَ مِنْ مَلَكَتِهِ، وَأَتَضَـرَّعُ إلَيْكَ في صَرفِ كَيدِهِ عَنّي
phrases.english: 96.I ask You to preserve me against his domination, and I plead with You to turn his trickery away from me!

phrases.arabic: و أسأَلُكَ فِي أَنْ تُسَهِّلَ إلَى رِزْقِي سَبِيلاً،
phrases.english: 97.I ask You to make the path to my provision easy,

phrases.arabic: فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى ابْتِدَائِكَ بِالنِّعَمِ الْجِسَامِ،
phrases.english: 98.since to You belongs praise for Your beginning with immense favours

phrases.arabic: وَإلْهَامِكَ الشُّكْرَ عَلَى الإحْسَانِ وَالإِنْعَامِ ،
phrases.english: 99.and Your inspiring gratitude for beneficence and bestowing favour!

phrases.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ
phrases.english: 100.Bless Muhammad and his Household,

phrases.arabic: وَسَهِّلْ عَلَيَّ رِزْقِي وَأَنْ تُقَنِّعَنِي بِتَقْدِيرِكَ لِيْ ،
phrases.english: 101.and make the way to my provision easy for me! [I ask You] to make me content with Your ordainment for me,

phrases.arabic: وَأَنْ  تُرْضِيَنِي بِحِصَّتِيْ فِيمَا قَسَمْتَ لِيْ،
phrases.english: 102.to make me satisfied with my lot in that which You hast apportioned for me

phrases.arabic: وَأَنْ تَجْعَـلَ مَـا ذَهَبَ مِنْ جِسْمِيْ وَعُمُرِيْ
phrases.english: 103.and to place what has gone of my body and my life-span

phrases.arabic: فِي سَبِيْلِ طَاعَتِكَ إنَّكَ خَيْرُ الرَّازِقِينَ.
phrases.english: 104.into the path of Your obedience! Surely You art the Best of providers!

phrases.arabic: أللَهُمَّ إنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مَنْ نَارٍ تَغَلَّظْتَ بِهَا عَلَى مَنْ عَصَاكَ،
phrases.english: 105.O God, I seek refuge in You from the Fire through which You art harsh toward him who disobeys You

phrases.arabic: وَتَوَعَّدْتَ بِهَا مَنْ صَدَفَ عَنْ رِضَاكَ،
phrases.english: 106.and by which You hast threatened him who turns away from Your good pleasure;

phrases.arabic: وَمِنْ نَارٍ نورُهَا ظُلْمَة وَهَيِّنُهَا أَلِيمٌ، وَبَعِيدُهَا قَرِيبٌ،
phrases.english: 107.from the Fire whose light is darkness, whose ease is pain, and whose far is near;

phrases.arabic: وَمِنْ نَارٍ يَأْكُلُ بَعْضَهَا بَعْضٌ،
phrases.english: 108.from the Fire parts of which devour parts

phrases.arabic: وَيَصُولُ بَعْضُهَا عَلَى بَعْض،
phrases.english: 109.and parts of which leap upon parts;

phrases.arabic: وَمِنْ نَارٍ تَذَرُ الْعِظَامَ رَمِيماً،
phrases.english: 110.from the Fire which leaves bones decayed

phrases.arabic: وَتَسْقِي أَهْلَهَا حَمِيماً ،
phrases.english: 111.and lets its people drink boiling water;

phrases.arabic: وَمِنْ نَارٍ لاَ تُبْقِي عَلَى مَنْ تَضَرَّعَ إلَيْهَا،
phrases.english: 112.from the Fire which 'does not spare him who pleads to it,'

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ تَرْحَمُ مَنِ اسْتَعْطَفَهَا،
phrases.english: 113.has no mercy on him who seeks sympathy from it,

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ تَقْدِرُ عَلَى التَّخْفِيفِ عَمَّنْ خَشَعَ لَهَا وَاسْتَسْلَمَ إلَيْهَا،
phrases.english: 114.and has no power to relieve him who humbles himself before it and yields himself to it;

phrases.arabic: تَلْقَى سُكَّانَهَا بِأَحَرِّ مَا لَدَيْهَا مِنْ أَلِيْمِ النَّكَالِ وَشَدِيدِ الْوَبَالِ،
phrases.english: 115.it meets its inhabitants with the hottest that it possesses: painful punishment and intense noxiousness.

phrases.arabic: وَأَعُوذُ بكَ مِنْ عَقَارِبِهَا الْفَاغِرَةِ أَفْوَاهُهَا،
phrases.english: 116.seek refuge in You from its gaping-jawed scorpions,

phrases.arabic: وَحَيّاتِهَا الصَّالِقَةِ بِأَنْيَابِهَا،
phrases.english: 117.its scraping-toothed serpents,

phrases.arabic: وَشَرَابِهَا الَّذِي يُقَطِّعُ أَمْعَاءَ وَأَفْئِدَةَ سُكَّانِهَا، وَيَنْزِعُ قُلُوبَهُمْ،
phrases.english: 118.and its drinks, which tear apart the intestines and hearts of its inhabitants and root out their marrows.

phrases.arabic: وَأَسْتَهْدِيْكَ لِمَا باعَدَ مِنْهَا وَأَخَّرَ عَنْهَا.
phrases.english: 119.I ask guidance from You to that which will keep far from it and make it retreat!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِـهِ
phrases.english: 120.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

phrases.arabic: وَأَجِرْنِي مِنْهَا بِفَضْل رَحْمَتِكَ،
phrases.english: 121.grant me sanctuary from it through the bounty of Your mercy,

phrases.arabic: وَأَقِلْنِي عَثَرَاتِي بِحُسْنِ إقَالَتِكَ ،
phrases.english: 122.release me from my stumbles through Your good releasing,

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ تَخْذُلْنِي يَا خَيْرَ الْمُجيرِينَ
phrases.english: 123.and abandon me not, O Best of the sanctuary-granters!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ  إنَّكَ تَقِي الْكَرِيهَةَ ، وَتُعْطِي الْحَسَنَةَ ،
phrases.english: 124.O God, You protectest from the disliked, givest the good,

phrases.arabic: وَتَفْعَلُ مَا  تُرِيـدُ وَأَنْتَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْء قَدِيرٌ.
phrases.english: 125.dost what You wilt, and You art "powerful over everything" (3:26).

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، إذَا ذُكِرَ الأبْرَارُ،
phrases.english: 126.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household when the pious are mentioned

phrases.arabic: وَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ مَا اخْتَلَفَ اللَّيْلُ وَالنَّهَارُ
phrases.english: 127.and bless Muhammad and his Household as long as night and day come

phrases.arabic: صَلاَةً لاَ يَنْقَطِعُ مَدَدُهَا،
phrases.english: 128.and go with a blessing whose replenishment is never cut off

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ يُحْصَى عَدَدُهَا صَلاَةً تَشْحَنُ الْهَوَاءَ،
phrases.english: 129.and whose number cannot be counted, a blessing that will fill up the air

phrases.arabic: وَتَمْلاُ الأرْضَ وَالسَّماءَ.
phrases.english: 130.and crowd the earth and the heaven!

phrases.arabic: صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ حَتَّى يَرْضَى،
phrases.english: 131.God bless him until he is well pleased

phrases.arabic: وَصَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ  وَآلِهِ
phrases.english: 132.and God bless him and his Household

phrases.arabic: بَعْدَ الرِّضَا صَلاَةً لا حَدَّ لَها
phrases.english: 133.after good pleasure with a blessing that has neither bound

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ مُنْتَهَى يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ.
phrases.english: 134.nor utmost limit! O Most Merciful of the merciful!
